_comment: MongoDB MCP Server configuration for Sentinel. This file is used to connect Google Cloud Agent Builder to the official mongodb-mcp-server, enabling Gemini 3.5 Flash to dynamically discover and call MongoDB operations at runtime via the Model Context Protocol.

agentBuilderIntegration.serverUrl: See README for Cloud Run deployment URL
agentBuilderIntegration.note: Gemini discovers these tools at runtime via MCP SDK handshake. No tool list needs to be hardcoded.
